roadmap.goal: Story #6248: the Work Items dialog brings the columns that explain why each item sits behind the point that was clicked. Four slices, each releasable on its own and delivered in order, never interleaved. Slice 01a (backend): every work-item and Feature row of the Team and Portfolio metrics endpoints, and a Feature's child items, carries its estimate, normalised by the code the Estimation chart uses (EstimateOf / EstimatesOf, WorkItemEstimateDto, set at the 12 owner-known sites), guarded by an ArchUnit seam test; Team Zenith's demo data gains a Story Points estimation field. Slice 01b: the column catalogue, the one declared defaults map, DataGridBase's defaults model with override-only persistence, per-context layout keys, and the estimation context, proven live by the E2E walking skeleton on Team Zenith. Slice 02: every chart and View Data context adopts its defaults, Parent shows names, and the Cumulative Time per State dialog opens at once with a loading and a could-not-load look. Slice 03: a Feature's child items (Delivery section, Team and Portfolio Feature lists) open through a keyed query with both looks, the Delivery timeline gains the catalogue, FeatureSchema gains currentStateEnteredAt, and highlightColumn is deleted. Done when every one of DISTILL's 213 pending cases (212 Vitest / NUnit cases plus the E2E walking skeleton) is un-skipped by exactly one step below and green, the 8 pins stay green except the one slice 03 deletes, and the project gates pass: `pnpm test`, `pnpm build` with zero warnings, `dotnet build` with zero warnings, the filtered `dotnet test`, and the E2E specs each slice touches run locally.
